retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s record cover featuring a high-contrast halftone portrait with bold, condensed sans-serif typography and a top-aligned stereo banner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a grainy, high-contrast portrait of a male subject in a white cardigan, framed by large, condensed sans-serif text in the upper corners and a list of tracks on the left. The image has a distinct CMYK halftone texture and a white header bar with a 'STEREO' label.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale typography flanking the central portrait
High-contrast subject against a dark, textured background
White horizontal banner at the top for technical metadata
Vertical list of secondary text balanced against primary titles
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern across the entire image
Condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif typeface for primary titles
Square 1:1 aspect ratio typical of vinyl records

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies approximately 70% of the frame, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright yellow text in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top right title, moves to the subject's face, then down to the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and dense typographic blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple and magenta tones in the halftone shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary artist name.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal or cyan for the tracklist and secondary titles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white cardigan and dark background; saturated primary colors for text.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to a simulated 4-color process palette

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family using scale and color to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Top horizontal banner with infinity-style icons
Small logo in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides the mid-century industrial sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy halftone portrait of a man in a white knit cardigan against a dark background. Include a white horizontal bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the top corners (yellow on the right, grey on the left). Add a vertical list of smaller teal text on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the text condensed and uppercase?
Is there a white banner at the top?
Is the color palette limited to CMYK-style tones?

postGenerationChecks: Verify halftone screen is applied to the image.
Ensure text is flush left and tightly packed.
Check that the top banner is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the color of the artist name is a vibrant yellow.
Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present.
recipe.reuseFormula: Halftone Portrait + Condensed Sans-Serif + Top Banner + Square Layout
